name: Eli Lilly
notes: revenue = 'Revenue' (pre-2005 'Net sales'). Lilly reports no operating income line in any year, so operatingIncome is derived for all years (quality estimated) from the income statement as revenue less cost of sales, research and development, marketing/selling and administrative, acquired in-process R&D (and development milestones) and asset impairment, restructuring and other special charges. Interest expense and 'Other income/expense, net' (interest, investment gains and losses, other) are excluded. Acquired IPR&D and special charges stay in, so 2008 (4.8bn ImClone and other IPR&D charges, 2.0bn special charges) is a loss. Each year as first reported in its 10-K (2000-2001 from the FY2002 Exhibit 13, 2010-2012 from FY2012, 2013-2015 from FY2015, 2020-2022 from FY2022). 2018 and earlier include Elanco animal health; 2019+ exclude it (FY2019 10-K restates 2018 to 3,534.5 and 2017 to 2,003.3). From 2018 non-service pension cost moved out of operating costs (ASU 2017-07): 2017 on the new basis would be 1,896.9 instead of 2,145.0.
